shared_contract.decision_schedule: unchanged every-fifth CY-006 market session after 120 causal steps
shared_contract.entry: immediately following market-session open; blocked or invalid names skipped
shared_contract.universe: unchanged historical CY-006 .SH/.SZ hard-valid, non-ST, tradable signal rows with 120 causal action-coordinate steps and prior-20 mean amount >= 50m CNY
shared_contract.screen_selection: top 20 per family/date; bottom 20 only for full cross-sectional definitions; twenty deterministic date controls
shared_contract.corporate_actions: unchanged causal visible-action coordinate and fail-closed path accounting from ASHARE-INDEP-FUNNEL-001

track_a.question: Does fixed cross-industry diversification retain the accepted industry-leadership effect while removing its severe-loss disadvantage?

alpha_frozen.state: leave-one-out industry mean 20-session causal action-coordinate return

single_translation.industry_selection: three highest equal-weight industry mean r20 states, ties by industry label
single_translation.security_selection: five highest prior-20 mean-amount eligible securities within each selected industry, ties by symbol
single_translation.weights: one third per industry and one fifteenth per security
single_translation.cohort_allocation: one quarter of current NAV each weekly entry because four h20 vintages overlap
single_translation.exit: first sell-executable open after the twentieth holding-session close

matched_concentration_control.purpose: diagnostic isolation of concentration risk, not a second candidate
matched_concentration_control.selection: highest industry state then fifteen highest prior-20 mean-amount securities

stock_industry_residual_strength_20.mechanism: stock-specific strength after removing contemporaneous PIT-industry leadership
stock_industry_residual_strength_20.score: stock r20 minus leave-one-out industry mean r20
stock_industry_residual_strength_20.event_filter: known PIT industry with at least five other eligible constituents

industry_diffusion_20.mechanism: broad internal industry participation rather than leadership-return level
industry_diffusion_20.score: leave-one-out fraction of eligible industry constituents with positive r20
industry_diffusion_20.event_filter: known PIT industry with at least five other eligible constituents

negative_gap_recovery.mechanism: overnight supply shock absorbed by same-session recovery
negative_gap_recovery.score: negative causal gap depth plus open-to-close recovery
negative_gap_recovery.event_filter: causal coordinate open below prior coordinate close and close above open

limit_up_aftermath.mechanism: persistent demand after an objectively closed limit-up session
limit_up_aftermath.score: prior-20 mean amount for capacity-first selection among exact limit-up closes
limit_up_aftermath.event_filter: raw close equals registered up-limit price

price_volume_disagreement.mechanism: positive signed-volume pressure without positive 20-session price response
price_volume_disagreement.event_filter: signed-volume share positive and r20 nonpositive

low_idiosyncratic_volatility_20.mechanism: low stock-specific risk after removing each date's cross-sectional median return
low_idiosyncratic_volatility_20.score: negative 20-session standard deviation of stock return minus daily market median

lower_wick_demand_rejection.mechanism: same-session rejection of downside excursion without requiring an objective support break
lower_wick_demand_rejection.event_filter: positive open-to-close session and lower wick exceeds upper wick

track_b_promotion.ranking_key: minimum early/late natural-horizon net mean excess, then full excess

executable_translation.exit: first sell-executable open after natural holding close

prohibited: no rerun or cosmetic modification of the seven prior exact formulations
no Industry Rotation horizon, signal, threshold, cost, habitat, weight, or diversification-count search
no Track-B neighboring parameter substitutes for prior rejected formulations
no CHINEXT tuning, validation, or combination
no strict PIT-A, OOS, validation, live, or causal-mechanism claim
no second Track-A experiment and no rescue of a failed Track-B executable translation
